title: Summer Summit Cabbage (Summer Summit F1): Characteristics
metaDescription: Summer Summit cabbage is an F1 hybrid cabbage variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: Summer Summit cabbage is an F1 hybrid cabbage variety, also sold or known as Summer Summit F1. It is not a registered variety, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from Harbest Agribusiness (Seeds of Hope).

heroImage.alt: Vegetable terraces and plastic tunnels on the slopes of Mankayan, Benguet, the kind of farm where Summer Summit cabbage is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Summer Summit F1, this is the same cabbage. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [cabbage variety finder](/crop-varieties/cabbage), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [vegetables in the Philippines](/crops/vegetables-philippines).
Key facts about Summer Summit cabbage

blocks.caption: From its seller and farm sources

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

No day count or trial yield is published for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
No pest or disease ratings are published for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit cabbage fields most often: [bacterial soft rot](/diseases/soft-rot), [black rot of cabbage](/diseases/black-rot), [cabbage webworm](/pests/cabbage-webworm), [clubroot](/diseases/clubroot), [diamondback moth](/pests/diamondback-moth). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Where and when to plant Summer Summit cabbage

Most repolyo comes from the highlands, where it heads well. Lowland growers need a heat tolerant hybrid and a cool month. Pick a firm head that keeps on the trip to market. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for vegetables](/land-preparation/vegetable-land-preparation).

Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.

items.q: Is Summer Summit F1 the same as Summer Summit?
items.a: Yes. Summer Summit F1 is another name for Summer Summit. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of Summer Summit?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
